title: SG-2 · Remove execution, approve and retry routes from the server
summary: backend/internal/server serves no execution, approve or retry routes and has no execution or worker wiring
description: Context: Worldseed must not host development automation. The execution package and the worker module are already deleted, and server.New currently mounts only player, world, contribution and admin round routes. Desired behavior: the server package neither registers nor implements execution, approve or retry routes, and wires no execution or worker dependencies. Expected result: remaining server tests pass with all dependencies mocked, and the contribution and round routes are unchanged. Why: development automation lives in the devion project workseed.
acceptance_criteria: Given server.New, when /api/v1/admin/executions, /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/approve and /retry are requested with a valid admin token, then the response is 404 or 405 and no execution handler runs
Given the backend/internal/server package, when its Go sources are scanned, then none references internal/execution, storyforge/worker, or an execution handler
Given the remaining server tests run with mocks, when go test ./internal/server runs, then all pass
Given the contribution and round routes, when requested, then their statuses and bodies are identical to before

preserve: admin round routes and token middleware

technical_constraints: Go module backend; chi router; do not change contribution or round route patterns
definition_of_done: No execution, approve or retry route or wiring in backend/internal/server
